title: The subset construction's 8 states shrink to 3
notes: This is the DFA the subset construction builds from all 8 subsets for an NFA of contains ab. Four subsets are unreachable, and two of the rest are equivalent: 8 states become 3.
ops: start B; accept D F G H; A a,b -> A; B a -> E; B b -> B; C a -> A; C b -> D; D a,b -> D; E a -> E; E b -> F; F a -> H; F b -> F; G a,b -> D; H a -> H; H b -> F
